name: mpg123-decoder
reason: Pinned 1.0.3 MPEGDecoder.decode(Uint8Array) directly decodes both untagged valid controls with exact sample rate and decoded samples per channel (44100/12672 and 22050/6912); the mono control produces two PCM arrays, so channel count is not claimed. It bundles a compressed 99,479-byte libmpg123 WASM binary (SHA-256 f0e9e884...), related to the selected C mpg123 family but a different build. The binary has no name, DWARF debug_info/debug_line or sourceMappingURL custom sections; Node V8 coverage sees JavaScript wrapper files and no WASM source scripts. No source-attributed parser coverage or stable parser-owned AFL feedback is established, so this path remains unselected despite its 2,505,430 npm 30-day downloads. A pinned-source Emscripten rebuild with coverage would produce a different binary whose equivalence to the shipped artifact is unverified. Only the two valid controls were run, with no malformed inputs or fuzz campaign.

name: mp3-duration
reason: Pinned 1.1.0 documented mp3Duration(Buffer,false) walks MPEG frame headers to EOF and sums frame samples/sample rate, returning seconds rounded to milliseconds. Both untagged controls return 287 ms and 313 ms, exactly matching independent frame-count/sample-rate duration. Docker V8 covers its own index.js parser source. Opt-in AFL++ feedback hashes capped parser-function source-range hit counts (11 versus 12 frame calls), with three stable fresh-process repeats per control and zero parser features on a no-parse module load. This is input-length-sensitive execution feedback, not new branch or line coverage. The same package/release is verified in the MP3-with-ID3v2 cell for duration scope; no frame metadata or audio decode is exposed.

name: mp3-parser
reason: Documented readFrame(DataView,offset,false) walks every frame of both valid untagged controls to EOF; output matches independent MPEG header walker. Own source coverage and stable two-range/two-tuple bit-extraction differential are pinned.
